instruction: Target is a WordPress site (school website, DKV SMK Negeri 1 Pangkalpinang). Focus: identify WordPress version (core, theme, plugins) and find known CVEs exploitable on this installation. Enumerate wp-content/plugins, wp-content/themes, generator meta tags, readme.html, changelog, xmlrpc.php, wp-login.php, wp-json REST API user enumeration. Attempt version-specific exploit checks for any outdated core/plugin/theme versions found. Report each finding with CVE ID if applicable and a working PoC. Output findings in English.
